title: BOEING_2022_10K — Item 1. Business: four reportable segments
key_points: Boeing states it is organized based on the products and services it offers.
Boeing states it operates in four reportable segments.
The first listed reportable segment is Commercial Airplanes (BCA).

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Part I, Item 1. Business: reportable segments (p.1)
key_points: Boeing is organized by the products and services it offers and operates in four reportable segments: Commercial Airplanes (BCA), Defense, Space & Security (BDS), Global Services (BGS), and Boeing Capital (BCC).

BCA develops, produces and markets commercial jet aircraft; its in-production family includes the 737 narrow-body and the 767, 777 and 787 wide-body models, and production of the 747 wide-body ended in 2022.
BDS covers research, development, production and modification of manned and unmanned military aircraft and weapons systems, plus C4ISR, cyber/information solutions, satellites and space exploration.
BGS provides services to commercial and defense customers worldwide, sustaining aerospace platforms and systems.
BCC provides selective financing solutions for Boeing customers (operating leases, sales-type/finance leases, notes and other receivables).
raw_excerpt: We are organized based on the products and services we offer. We operate in four reportable segments: • Commercial Airplanes (BCA); • Defense, Space & Security (BDS); • Global Services (BGS); • Boeing Capital (BCC).
